The study by Tobian AAR, Dam KH, Van Lith LM, et al., published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2018, investigates healthcare providers' perceptions and training needs for counseling adolescents undergoing voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC). The article is found in volume 66, pages S198-S204. 2. A search strategy for PICO 1 was developed to identify relevant literature in various databases, including CINAHL, Embase, LILACS, MEDLINE, and PsycINFO. The search terms included variations of circumcision (e.g., No Circumci, Non Circumci, Uncircumci) and were limited to publications between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2018. 3. In CINAHL, the search strategy for PICO 1 included terms such as No Circumci, Non Circumci, and Uncircumci with publication date limits from 2007 to 2018. Similarly, Embase searches were restricted to titles and abstracts, with results limited to the years 2007 to the present. 4. The LILACS database search for PICO 1 included terms like No Circumci, Non Circumci, Uncircumci, and Not Circumci and was filtered by regional instances and publication years from 2007 to 2018. 5. MEDLINE searches for PICO 1 used terms such as Circumci and Circumciz in titles and abstracts, with results limited to publications from 2007 to the present. 6. PsycINFO searches for PICO 1 also focused on titles and abstracts, using similar terms, and were restricted to publications from 2007 onward. 7. For PICO 2, the search strategy in CINAHL combined terms related to circumcision (e.g., Circumci, Circumciz, VMMC) with terms related to disposable equipment and minimally invasive procedures (e.g., Changshu, Clamp, Plastibell, PrePex, ShangRing). The search was limited to publications from 2007 to 2018. 8. Embase searches for PICO 2 included terms related to circumcision and surgical devices, with results limited to publications from 2007 to the present. 9. LILACS searches for PICO 2 combined circumcision-related terms with device-related terms and were filtered by regional instances and publication years from 2007 to 2018. 10. MEDLINE searches for PICO 2 used similar terms and were restricted to publications from 2007 onward. 11. PsycINFO searches for PICO 2 included circumcision-related terms and device-related terms, with results limited to publications from 2007 onward. 12. For PICO 3, the search strategy in CINAHL combined circumcision-related terms (e.g., Circumci, Circumciz, VMMC) with terms related to adolescence (e.g., Adolescen, Boys, Teens, Youth). The search was limited to publications from 2007 to 2018. 13. Embase searches for PICO 3 included circumcision-related terms and adolescence-related terms, with results limited to publications from 2007 to the present. 14. LILACS searches for PICO 3 combined circumcision-related terms with adolescence-related terms and were filtered by regional instances and publication years from 2007 to 2018. 15. MEDLINE searches for PICO 3 used circumcision-related terms and adolescence-related terms, with results limited to publications from 2007 onward. 16. PsycINFO searches for PICO 3 included circumcision-related terms and adolescence-related terms, with results limited to publications from 2007 onward. Additional filters were applied to focus on specific age groups, such as adolescence (13 to 17 years) and school-age children (6 to 12 years).
